BiblicalUsage: The Aramaic word for darkness appears when Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar that God reveals deep and secret things and knows what is in the darkness. Darkness hides nothing from Him, and the light dwells with Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no secret of mine is hidden from God, and that is comfort rather than threat, because the God who sees the darkness also brings light.
